ig_caption:
An agent without guardrails is an incident waiting to happen 🚨

3 guardrails I put on every agent (real demo):
1️⃣ redaction: the customer types their email, the model only sees [email]
2️⃣ approvals for risky tools: "restart auth-api now" → restart_service BLOCKED, waiting for a human
3️⃣ a step limit, so a confused agent can't loop forever

All three are code in the harness, not prompts. A prompt can be talked around. Code can't.

Part 3/4 of Agent Platform in Production. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
